How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by leveraging the power of Cloudflare Pages to host the online store and process payments with NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, and the corresponding product is automatically delivered to the customer via Cloudflare R2.
